moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins this Friday, August 21st, with a full weekend of highly anticipated fixtures across the UK.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Premier League season kicks off this weekend, bringing all the drama, goals, and talking points. Who are you backing for glory?

angles.name: Coventry's Big Return
angles.copy: A huge moment for Coventry City as they return to the Premier League after 25 years, facing champions Arsenal on Friday night. What a start!

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz and UK club culture, runs from August 20th to 23rd in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, and is now sold out.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is bringing the best of jazz and UK club culture to Dorset this weekend! Who's soaking up the vibes?

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: Another sold-out year for We Out Here Festival! Proof that Gilles Peterson's curated blend of soul, hip hop, house, and jazz is a must-attend.

moments.title: Rewind Festival South Brings 80s Hits
moments.blurb: Rewind Festival South, the popular 80s music festival, takes over Henley-On-Thames from August 21st to 23rd, promising a weekend of nostalgia.

angles.name: Throwback Weekend
angles.copy: Get ready to rewind! Rewind Festival South is happening this weekend, bringing all your favourite 80s anthems to Henley-On-Thames. Who's going?

angles.name: Ultimate 80s Party
angles.copy: Leg warmers, big hair, and iconic tunes! Rewind Festival South is the ultimate 80s party, kicking off Friday. What's your go-to 80s track?

moments.title: Shirley Manson turns 60

angles.name: Happy Birthday Shirley!
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson from Garbage! A true rock icon.

angles.name: Garbage's Frontwoman
angles.copy: 60 years young! Shirley Manson, the powerhouse voice of Garbage, celebrates her birthday this week. What's your favourite Garbage track?

moments.title: Elvis Costello's 72nd Birthday

angles.name: Punk Rock Icon

angles.name: Musical Chameleon
angles.copy: 72 today! Elvis Costello has continuously reinvented himself over the decades. What's your favourite era of his music?

angles.copy: Happy Birthday to Dua Lipa, turning 31 this Saturday! From 'New Rules' to 'Dance The Night', she keeps delivering the hits.

angles.name: Voice of Deep Purple
